capability: Per-attempt budget admission and reconciliation in the general LLM pipeline workflow
evidence: Source: https://github.com/langchain-ai/langchain/tree/980e4a80d01f699ba359db139cd7c8bfc348c110. Read README, MIT license, and pinned model_call_limit.py, tool_call_limit.py and model_retry.py under libs/langchain_v1/langchain/agents/middleware. All fetched bytes matched Git blob hashes; no external code, tests or installers were executed or copied.

Observed statically: ModelCallLimitMiddleware checks run/thread counters in before_model and increments in after_model; the run field uses UntrackedValue. ModelRetryMiddleware separately calls its handler up to max_retries+1 times. Tool limits distinguish per-tool/global counts and blocked calls. These files alone do not prove middleware ordering, dispatcher persistence, a provider-attempt cap, or a shared monetary ceiling.

Searched canonical skills, rules and agents for budget, reservation, admission, retry, shared and in-flight controls. Read the general cost-aware owner plus cost-tracking, enterprise-agent-ops, autonomous-loops and the paths listed here. ECC-Tools audit already identifies pre-enqueue quota races; agent-payment-x402 already reserves worst-case payment exposure before await and retains it after uncertain dispatch. The gap is in the general cost-aware composition, not an absence of reservation patterns throughout ECC.

The previous composition checked only recorded spend before the whole retry wrapper and added only its final successful response. Replaced that example with per-attempt integration requirements: scoped units, conservative bounds, shared atomic admission, once-only settlement before parsing, retained uncertain exposure, and retry/fallback re-admission. These are portable design inferences informed by source inspection and existing local patterns, not claims that LangChain or the sample tracker enforces them.

Seven independently evaluated raw synthetic cases matched held-out decisions: exact budget boundary, parallel workers, unknown timeout, persistent cap with fallback/auth failure, duplicate settlement with parse failure and uncertain form replay, unavailable hard bound, and hidden SDK retries. Evidence concerns instruction decisions only; no provider billing, concurrency service or side-effecting runtime was tested. Generated the missing native projection and simple matching UI with maintained helpers; existing canonical package/install registration remains unchanged.
reason: Extend the existing owner rather than add a duplicate budget skill. Past-spend tracking and logical-call counts cannot establish a hard per-attempt/shared ceiling; the workflow must make admission, uncertain charges and actual adapter verification explicit.
